correctness.rationale: Balance the irreducible four-state count generator, normalize to J=6c(c+d)(c+2d)/D(rho), and differentiate. The derivative has the sign of H(rho), an affine function. The unique roots of H(0) and H(1) are d_- and d_+ with 0<d_-<d_+; this proves every monotonic and interior-minimum regime. Exact rational generator solver replayed 18,755 assertions; finite checks are not the universal proof.

value.rationale: The observable is a natural joint occupancy criterion when all habitat patches are needed. Changing correlation while holding each occupied patch catastrophe hazard fixed isolates disaster synchronization. Unlike the two-patch model, the smallest three-patch system admits a strict interior worst case; complete algebraic thresholds hold for every positive immigration, extinction and catastrophe rate and every nonnegative linear rescue rate. This is a meaningful qualitative boundary rather than an arbitrary numerical slice or a code-only enumeration.
